## RemoteRpcOutcome type

A decoded HTTP RPC envelope before application-error policy is selected. Successful wire values remain untouched; failures retain their full server envelope so compatibility facades can preserve arbitrary app error codes.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type RemoteRpcOutcome =
  | {
      readonly ok: true
      readonly result: unknown
    }
  | {
      readonly ok: false
      readonly envelope: unknown
      readonly status: number
    }
```
